name: NCAA D-III Midwest Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Rock Island, IL · host Augustana · Saukie Golf Course
headline: Midwest Regional: No. 1 Wartburg vs. No. 3 North Central
summary: Five ranked men’s teams at Saukie Golf Course: No. 1 Wartburg, No. 3 North Central (Ill.), No. 12 Chicago, No. 13 Washington (Mo.) and No. 19 Central (Iowa). The women’s race has No. 6 Chicago, No. 8 Washington (Mo.) and No. 20 Wartburg. Women run 6K at noon CT and men 8K at 1:00 p.m.
